Qualsiasi attività di security assessmen: Any security assessment, intrusive vulnerability scan or penetration test on real infrastructure requires written authorisation from the client or owner, with a defined scope, timing and techniques.
Prima di iniziare un test reale, documen: Before starting a real test, document at least:
Lettera o contratto di autorizzazione fi: A signed authorisation letter or contract.
Tecniche consentite e vietate (es. denia: Permitted and forbidden techniques (e.g. denial of service, social engineering against employees).
Regole su dati sensibili, retention e di: Rules on sensitive data, retention and destruction of dumps.
<strong>Regola pratica:</strong> se non: Rule of thumb: if you cannot show an authorisation document, do not run the test. EVIL teaches methodologies; responsibility for running them on real networks always lies with you and the client.
